name: web
//test: RUN BY CI via .github/workflows/web-ci.yml, and repo-guards.sh guard 5 fails the build if that workflow stops running it. The GLOB is load-bearing: `node --test tests/` cannot be used (node resolves a bare directory as a module and errors MODULE_NOT_FOUND), so a filename pinned here would mean a SECOND web test file silently never runs — guard 5 asserts the glob for that reason. Node >= 22.18 (native TypeScript type-stripping); TZ is pinned so the DST cases are deterministic.
